text:
sam.wallace: VendorAuth sent a security bulletin and emailed us — possible debug log leak that may include bearer tokens. https://vendorauth.example/notice
maria.chen: Thanks. Any IOC or affected time window? Is this the provider we use for SSO/service-to-service?
vendor-security: We're VendorAuth sec team. Initial report: some debug logs stored in a shared bucket contained truncated bearer tokens. Affected time window 2025-03-02 02:10-03:05 UTC. We have rotated all service tokens and are revoking leaked tokens.
alex.kim: Which of our apps used that integration? I think SSO and a service client in infra. tagging eng-platform for visibility.
sre-oncall: Confirmed: we have two service principals using VendorAuth: 'redwood-ci' and 'metric-forwarder'. Opening incident ticket INF-4721.
sam.wallace: Can we confirm whether any shipped customer tokens were in logs? Vendor says truncated tokens, unclear if valid.
vendor-security: We do not see successful token exchange using leaked tokens. No external access patterns correlated to those tokens in our logs. We will provide a signed attestation by EOD.
maria.chen: Immediate actions: 1) Rotate VendorAuth client secret for redwood-ci and metric-forwarder. 2) Rotate any KMS keys if used to encrypt logs? 3) Increase audit logging retention for that window.
alex.kim: Rotating client secrets now. Commands:
```
# rotate vendor auth client
vault write auth/vendor/client/redwood-ci secret=@new-secret
kubectl rollout restart deploy/ci-agent
```
sre-oncall: Metric-forwarder secret rotated and deployment restarted. Not seeing any auth failures in post-rotation traces.
eng-security: Also recommend forcing reissue of tokens via VendorAuth admin API. Maria, can you coordinate with VendorAuth to confirm invalidation endpoint?
maria.chen: Reached out to vendor-security privately. They confirmed invalidation endpoint used and tokens revoked.
legal-ops: Heads up — this may be PII/PCI scope depending on logs. Please preserve all relevant logs and vendor communications. Do not delete anything.
sam.wallace: I've created a dedicated channel and added legal. Also start an incident timeline doc and link the ticket.
vendor-security: Postmortem plan: ephemeral credentials fixed, bucket ACLs tightened, improved log scrubbing on our side, and we will provide a root cause and remediation timeline in 48 hours.
alex.kim: Quick check on KMS: did we ever use our KMS keys to encrypt the debug logs? If yes, we need to audit key usage and consider key rotation.
eng-security: We do not encrypt vendor logs with our KMS; vendor stores them. But we ingest some debug logs into our blob for analysis — those are encrypted with kms/redwood-logs. We'll audit access now.
sre-oncall: Audit query (running):
```
gcloud logging read "resource.type=container AND timestamp>='2025-03-02T02:00:00Z' AND jsonPayload.message:VendorAuth" --project=redwood-prod
```
sre-oncall: No suspicious external IPs found in our access logs correlated to those timestamps.
maria.chen: Next steps: 1) keep all rotated creds on a temp allowlist. 2) vendor to provide signed attestation and IOCs. 3) security to run token misuse scan. 4) schedule post-incident review in 72 hours.
eng-security: Will run token misuse scan across auth logs and report findings in INF-4721.
legal-ops: If vendor attestation shows data exposure affecting customers, escalate to comms and privacy. For now document only internal incident.
sam.wallace: Thanks everyone. Will update ticket with rotation artifacts and attach vendor attestation when available. :white_check_mark: 
vendor-security: Attestation uploaded: https://vendorauth.example/attestations/1762543321-signed.pdf. We'll follow up with RCA in 48h.
alex.kim: Closing action for now: verify CI pipelines didn't leak secrets to public; grep for vendor client secret pattern across recent commits.
eng-security: Found one commit in infra-utils that logged token partials to stdout in tests. PR opened to remove logging. CI job to scrub test logs on retention shorter window.
sam.wallace: Great. We'll reconvene after RCA. Incident status: contained. last update in ticket INF-4721.
